expected_title: System Resilience Framework and Modeling for a CubeSat System
abstract: System resilience is an innovative and affordable approach for complex systems to circumvent, surv ive, and recover from disruptions. Resilience is recognized in various fields of study . S pecifically in systems engineering, there are several definitions of system resilience. This makes it challenging when conducting trade studies with respect to system resilience characteristics. The objectives of this paper are to document existing system resilience related definitions , propose a means to capture systems resilience for use as a future tradeoff ility in Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and propose a method to model system resilience in CubeSat systems . System resilience is highly dependent on system behavior, reliability, operational availability, system state, real -­‐‑ time constraints , and potential unknowns.
